headline: US Stocks Surge and Oil Plunges Following Democratic Midterm Victories
summary: US stocks rose and bond yields fell as investors digested Democratic midterm election victories, while crude oil prices tumbled by roughly 8% amid expectations of a potential easing of tensions with Iran.
why: Midterm congressional elections shift the balance of power in Washington, directly impacting federal budget expectations, regulatory outlooks, and foreign policy measures that influence global energy supplies and market valuations.

impacts.name: US 10-year Treasury yield
impacts.why: Government bond yields declined as markets reacted to the political shift.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors adjusted portfolios following the Democratic victories in the US midterm elections, easing fears over political friction and driving down crude oil prices on prospects of geopolitical detente.
